'''Residue''' is a mushy snow-like block which appears in specific situations, starting when [[Generations]] reaches Generation 4.  It will only drop itself when mined with a shovel.

Touching it inflicts the [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]] Effect for 3 minutes.

== ''Functioning'' ==
Residue is generated in several occasions:

*The Cleansing of [[Infested Blocks]], whether that be from the death of a [[Stage I Beckon]] or the usage of a [[Quench]].
*A Land [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted Parasite]] pukes some (only if [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher).
*A [[Heavy Carrier|Heavy]] or [[Light Carrier]] explodes.
*A [[Host]] or [[Herd]] traveling underground.
*A [[Succor]] explodes.

In all cases, there's a chance<ref>1/20000 per tick if [[Evolution Phases]] are disabled, 

Phase 4: 1/4000 per tick, 

Phase 5: 1/1000 per tick, 

Phase 6: 1/500 per tick, 

Phase 7:  1/400 per tick, 

Phase 8: 1/300 per tick.</ref> that a [[Stage I Beckon]] will spawn from Residue via [[Reinforcement System]]. Such chance is calculated every random tick.
